places.quote: The house to which Oliver had been conveyed, was in the neighborhood of Whitechapel.
places.note: Location of the house where Oliver was taken; not visited in this passage.

places.quote: crossed the road, and struck off in the direction of the Spitalfields.
places.note: Written as 'the Spitalfields'; the Jew is walking towards it.

places.quote: He kept on his course, through many winding and narrow ways, until he reached Bethnal Green;
"About the crib at Chertsey, Bill?" said the Jew,
places.note: The crib (house to be robbed) is at Chertsey; the house itself is unnamed.
